syl: ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏗ ᎤᎵᏬᏨ ᏗᎦᎾᏗ ᏣᏄᏍᏕᎢ,
pho: gó:sda:yi digá:hlti:sdóhdi gá:ye:sadv´:'i u:li:hwo:tsv di:gandi tsinu:sdei,

syl: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏳᎧᏗ ᎤᎾᏕᎶᎰᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᏍᎩᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏆ ᏧᏃᏔᏁᎢ
pho: aseno tsiyú:gdi u:ndeló:hosdi tsundu:lísge ani:tsalagi sgi:yú:sdi é:gwa tsuno:tané:'i
eng: but to make sure, the Cherokees built a big fire
and threw the witch on it.

syl: ᏍᎩᏴᏃ ᎠᏥᎳ ᎠᎪᎲᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏴᏫ ᏣᎾᏴᎩᏍᎨ
pho: sgiyvhno atsí:la agó:hvsgv´ hí'a ani:yv:wiyá tsani:tv:gí:sge
eng: As the fire burned, the people heard
songs coming from the fire, songs of healing.

syl: ᏍᎩᏴ ᎤᏐᏅᎢ ᎠᏓᏪᎯ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏍᏗ ᎩᎳᎯᏯ ᏧᏂᏲᏍᏓᏁᎢ,
pho: sgiyv u:so:nv´'i adawé:hi go:sdáyi digá:tisdóhdi gá:yesad(i) kilá:hí:ya tsuni:yó:sdané:'i,
eng: When the evil magic of Spearfinger was finally destroyed,

syl: ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᏧᎾᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎢ ᏃᎴ ᏧᎾᎾᎾᏖᎢ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏓ ᎯᎪᎢᎦ.
pho: hí'a ani:tsalagi unatvganv nole unanta sgina dikahno:gí:da hi:go í:ga.
eng: The Cherokees listened, and they remember those songs to this day.
